info.title: OptimAI x402 API
info.description: OptimAI is an agent-ready decentralized search and retrieval service powered by the OptimAI Network nodes, returning real-time contextual answers with citations from web, social, and crypto sources.
info.x-guidance: Use POST /external/v1/x402/search with application/json {"query":"..."}. If the response is 402, read the payment-required header, satisfy one accepted x402 v2 payment requirement, then retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE. A successful paid request returns an accepted OptimAI Search request for agent-ready web, social, and crypto research with cited results.

post.summary: Create an x402-paid OptimAI Search request
post.description: Submit a natural-language search or research question and receive an asynchronous OptimAI Search request.

search_mode.description: Select standard Search or text-only Agent mode.

202.description: Search request accepted after x402 payment verification.

402.description: Payment Required. Inspect the payment-required header for x402 requirements.
